[[Deldrimor Recurve Bow (unique)|Deldrimor Recurve Bow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] traded by the [[Artisan of Nature]], a [[collector]] in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:Lengthens [[Crippled]] duration on foes by 33%
:[[Health]] +30 

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as the non-unique [[Deldrimor Recurve Bow]].

== Replica ==
It is possible to create an exact replica of this item with:
*[[Deldrimor Recurve Bow]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
*[[Crippling]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Strength and Honor]]" inscription
